_about: Phase 8 content pass, 17 September 2026. Every description is written from the record's own imported copy or its real links (route, stops, itinerary steps, highlights) and nothing else: no prices, ratings, 'best', certifications or claims the client has not made. Applied by scripts/content/apply-seo.mts, which only fills empty fields and never overwrites text someone has written in the CMS.
